tiles.name: Visits by landing page
tiles.description: Consenting readers only, v3. Landing type is fixed at the start of the PostHog session.

tiles.name: Visits by referrer domain
tiles.description: Referrer domains only; query strings and referrer paths are removed.

tiles.name: Native web analytics and bounce
tiles.description: PostHog native bounce definition; separate from the custom low-engagement exit measure. Consenting v3 population.

tiles.name: Visible story sections
tiles.description: One visible marker per section and route occurrence. Read next corresponds to the Related stories section.

tiles.name: Recommendation opportunities and clicks
tiles.description: One exposure and one click per source, target, position and visit. Clicks establish exposure if the observer has not fired. CTR is clicks / exposures at each position.

tiles.name: Feed continuation outcomes
tiles.description: Current Latest feed. Successful, empty, failed and cancelled requests are separate; legacy home_feed_load is excluded.

tiles.name: Useful onward actions
tiles.description: Source navigation and confirmed copy outcomes. A destination selection is intent, not a confirmed social post.

tiles.name: First-observed and returning sessions
tiles.description: Reader type uses anonymous first observed session, not account identity. Compare only within the consent rollout population.

tiles.name: Second-story rate by device
tiles.description: Sessions with at least two distinct stories / sessions with at least one, over 14 complete days. Reloads do not qualify. Derived v3 definition.

query.query:
SELECT device, count() AS story_sessions,
    countIf(stories >= 2) AS second_story_sessions,
    countIf(stories >= 2) / nullIf(count(), 0) AS second_story_rate
FROM (
    SELECT distinct_id, properties.$session_id AS session_id,
        argMin(properties.$device_type, timestamp) AS device,
        count(DISTINCT properties.story_id) AS stories
    FROM events
    WHERE event = 'story_view' AND properties.app = 'hacksnap'
      AND toInt(properties.contract_version) = 3
      AND timestamp >= toStartOfDay(now()) - INTERVAL 14 DAY
      AND timestamp < toStartOfDay(now())
    GROUP BY distinct_id, session_id
)
GROUP BY device

tiles.name: Active reading by category and device
tiles.description: Max cumulative seconds per story visit, including visits without a snapshot as zero. Median and share reaching 30 seconds. Derived v3 definition.

query.query:
SELECT device, category, count() AS story_visits,
    quantile(0.5)(active_seconds) AS median_active_seconds,
    countIf(active_seconds >= 30) / nullIf(count(), 0) AS share_reaching_30_seconds
FROM (
    SELECT distinct_id, properties.visit_id AS visit_id, properties.story_id AS story_id,
        argMin(properties.$device_type, timestamp) AS device,
        argMin(properties.category_id, timestamp) AS category,
        max(toFloatOrZero(properties.active_seconds)) AS active_seconds
    FROM events
    WHERE event IN ('story_view', 'story_engagement') AND properties.app = 'hacksnap'
      AND toInt(properties.contract_version) = 3
      AND timestamp >= toStartOfDay(now()) - INTERVAL 14 DAY
      AND timestamp < toStartOfDay(now())
    GROUP BY distinct_id, visit_id, story_id
    HAVING countIf(event = 'story_view') > 0
)
GROUP BY device, category

tiles.name: Seven-day return — matured cohorts
tiles.description: Anonymous browsers returning in another session within seven elapsed days of first observed pageview. Only cohorts aged at least seven days. Derived v3 definition; no account identity.

query.query:
WITH first_visits AS (
    SELECT distinct_id, min(timestamp) AS first_at,
        argMin(properties.$session_id, timestamp) AS first_session,
        argMin(properties.$device_type, timestamp) AS device
    FROM events
    WHERE event = '$pageview' AND properties.app = 'hacksnap'
      AND toInt(properties.contract_version) = 3
      AND timestamp >= toDateTime('2026-10-16 00:00:00')
    GROUP BY distinct_id
    HAVING first_at >= toStartOfDay(now()) - INTERVAL 21 DAY
       AND first_at < now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY
), readers AS (
    SELECT f.distinct_id AS reader, f.first_at AS first_at, f.device AS device,
        max(e.timestamp > f.first_at
            AND e.timestamp <= f.first_at + INTERVAL 7 DAY
            AND e.properties.$session_id != f.first_session) AS returned
    FROM first_visits AS f
    JOIN events AS e ON e.distinct_id = f.distinct_id
    WHERE e.event = '$pageview' AND e.properties.app = 'hacksnap'
      AND toInt(e.properties.contract_version) = 3
      AND e.timestamp >= toStartOfDay(now()) - INTERVAL 21 DAY
    GROUP BY reader, first_at, device
)
SELECT toDate(first_at) AS cohort, device, count() AS matured_readers,
    sum(returned) AS returning_readers,
    sum(returned) / nullIf(count(), 0) AS seven_day_return
FROM readers
GROUP BY cohort, device
ORDER BY cohort

tiles.name: Low-engagement exits by device
tiles.description: Closed sessions with one pageview, under 30 active seconds and no useful onward action. Heartbeats and autocapture never qualify as useful actions. Derived v3 measure, not native bounce.

query.query:
SELECT device, count() AS closed_sessions,
    countIf(pageviews = 1 AND active_seconds < 30 AND useful_actions = 0) AS low_engagement_exits,
    countIf(pageviews = 1 AND active_seconds < 30 AND useful_actions = 0) / nullIf(count(), 0) AS low_engagement_exit_rate
FROM (
    SELECT distinct_id, properties.$session_id AS session_id,
        argMin(properties.$device_type, timestamp) AS device,
        countIf(event = '$pageview') AS pageviews,
        max(toFloatOrZero(properties.active_seconds)) AS active_seconds,
        countIf(event IN ('story_click', 'recommendation_click', 'outbound_click', 'share_copy_success', 'story_return')) AS useful_actions
    FROM events
    WHERE properties.app = 'hacksnap'
      AND toInt(properties.contract_version) = 3
      AND timestamp >= toStartOfDay(now()) - INTERVAL 14 DAY
    GROUP BY distinct_id, session_id
    HAVING max(timestamp) < now() - INTERVAL 30 MINUTE AND pageviews > 0
)
GROUP BY device
